description: Maps each DB-stored scenario (by exact title) for the U.S. Federal R&D Pullback topic to the 4 curated deck scenarios shown in the Wiley Horizons brief. The DB scenarios are the canonical evidence base; this overlay provides the public-facing framing.

federal_rd_funding_decline.deck_scenario_name: Federal R&D Funding Decline and Policy Uncertainty
federal_rd_funding_decline.primary_signal: Sustained federal budget cuts and politicization will suppress innovation ecosystems, erode public trust, and complicate research governance through the 2025-2032 period.
federal_rd_funding_decline.minority_view: Some scenarios foresee continued prioritization of traditional research domains and breakthrough biotech advances despite funding constraints.

decision_fork.favorable: If federal funding continues to decline with political interference: innovation pipelines and talent development weaken, increasing reliance on private and international R&D partnerships.
decision_fork.adverse: If policy stabilizes with restored leadership and funding: traditional domains like cancer and neurodegenerative research regain momentum, enabling leverage of federal grants and public trust.

action_windows.0_6_months: Assess funding exposure and leadership risks

private_open_source_innovation.deck_scenario_name: Private Sector and Open Source as Innovation Drivers
private_open_source_innovation.primary_signal: Private and open-source innovation ecosystems will expand rapidly, enabling agile market growth especially in AI and biotechnology, compensating for federal funding shortfalls.
private_open_source_innovation.minority_view: Some scenarios emphasize ongoing federal research governance challenges and political frictions that may limit private sector impact.

decision_fork.favorable: If organizations engage early with open-source and private AI innovators: they capture emerging market opportunities and accelerate product development leveraging global talent pools.
decision_fork.adverse: If political and regulatory frictions intensify: innovation ecosystems become fragmented, requiring strategic advocacy and adaptive governance engagement.

action_windows.0_6_months: Evaluate partnerships with private and open-source innovators
action_windows.6_18_months: Invest in AI and biotech pilot projects driven by non-federal actors

quantum_biotech_breakthroughs.primary_signal: Quantum computing and AI-driven personalized biotechnologies will become commercially viable, enabling disruption in data security, diagnostics, and therapies.
quantum_biotech_breakthroughs.minority_view: A minority anticipate slower technology maturation due to funding constraints and governance challenges.

decision_fork.favorable: If organizations strategically invest in emerging quantum and biotech platforms: they achieve competitive advantage through disruptive innovation in healthcare and security sectors.
decision_fork.adverse: If adoption is delayed by regulatory or funding limitations: competitors with early integration capture dominant market positions, marginalizing late movers.

action_windows.0_6_months: Monitor quantum and biotech tech validation and pilot results
action_windows.6_18_months: Build capabilities for commercial deployment of breakthrough technologies

science_policy_trust_restoration.primary_signal: Integrated governance blending scientific expertise with transparent policy will enable sustainable innovation environments and rebuild credibility.
science_policy_trust_restoration.minority_view: Some scenarios highlight persistent politicization and skepticism undermining long-term trust recovery.

decision_fork.favorable: If organizations actively engage in science-policy advocacy and transparent communication: they secure stable regulatory conditions facilitating innovation and market confidence.
decision_fork.adverse: If distrust and politicization persist: organizations face regulatory uncertainty and reputational risks limiting growth.

action_windows.0_6_months: Engage in policy dialogues and trust-building initiatives
action_windows.6_18_months: Integrate compliance and transparency practices to align with emerging frameworks
